population: NHANES 2009-2010 fasting morning MEC adults age40-79; positive fasting subsample weights and complete BMI/reference TG.
requirements: Preserve all observed cells and row order; append finite positive tg_mg_dl.
Use approved non-NHANES source evidence only; target-containing pooled publications excluded.
No custodian inspection, outcome-table fetch, record linkage, or prior target result reading.
Freeze both candidates and all seeds before target release; no post-release tuning.
boundary: Procedural role boundary; not OS isolation or protection against model pretraining.
classification: Audit-limited unused temporal holdout within NHANES; not independent study.
assay_token_limitation: legacy_proxy is the inherited generator compatibility token; exact target is NHANES2009-2010 glycerol-blanked Roche Modular P. Mapping to the legacy source model is an explicit measurement approximation, not equivalence.
